article.headline: Ryan Massey scores 23 as North Dakota State tops D-III's Wisconsin-Stout 84-49
article.description: — Riley Massey had 23 points in North Dakota State’s 84-49 win over Division III's Wisconsin-Stout on Monday.
article.linkText: Ryan Massey scores 23 as North Dakota State tops D-III's Wisconsin-Stout 84-49

keywords: Wisconsin Stout Blue Devils @ North Dakota State Bison
article.story: FARGO, N.D. -- — Riley Massey had 23 points in North Dakota State’s 84-49 win over Division III's Wisconsin-Stout on Monday. Massey also contributed six rebounds for the Bison (3-5). Rob Diaz III scored 14 points while finishing 7 of 13 from the floor, and added five rebounds and three steals. Andrew Nagy had nine points and shot 3 for 7, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. A.J. Uttech finished with 22 points and two steals for the Blue Devils. Wesley Mboga added eight points. Up next: North Dakota State hosts North Texas in its next matchup on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
